purpose: Teach: まったり/でかけ/ご機嫌/困ら/頑固/恨み/不器用/留守番

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 土曜、まったりした時間が欲しいの。
lines.en: On Saturday, I'd like some unhurried time together.
lines.style: Gentle opening, almost tentative. Soft breath. Warm underneath—not asking much, just saying what she needs. Trails slightly upward at the end like a small, sincere hope.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん、どこかにでかけてもいいよね。
lines.en: Yeah, going out could be nice too.
lines.style: Agreeable, easy. A small smile in the voice. Not forcing—she's listening and building on what Mei said. Light, genuinely warm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 最近、夫がご機嫌で、家、明るいの。
lines.en: Lately he's been in better spirits, so home feels brighter.
lines.style: Quiet relief underneath. Speaking slowly, like she's noticing it as she says it. A soft brightness—not exclaiming, just acknowledging something good. Slight pause between thoughts.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: よかった!困らせない夫、いいね。
lines.en: I'm glad. A husband who doesn't add to your burden—that's really something.
lines.style: Genuine warmth. Leaning in slightly with the compliment. Not patronizing—she means it. Small emphasis on 「いいね」 as real recognition, not platitude.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 前は頑固で、私の頼みも聞かなかった。
lines.en: He used to be stubborn, wouldn't listen to what I needed.
lines.style: Quiet, looking back. Not bitter—factual, but weighted. Pause before the second clause. Her voice softens slightly, like she's being fair to him even as she remembers the difficulty.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 恨みって、引きずる必要ないよ。
lines.en: But you don't have to carry old resentment with you.
lines.style: Gentle wisdom, not preaching. Steady, measured. She's speaking from observation, not judgment. Warm and quiet—the kind of thing said after listening well.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 私、感情表現が不器用なの。
lines.en: I've never been very good at expressing what I feel.
lines.style: Vulnerable admission. Slow, hesitant—like she's trusting Aoi with something she doesn't often say. Soft, almost self-conscious. No defensiveness, just honesty.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 子供が留守番できる年齢になって、楽でしょ。
lines.en: And now that your child's old enough to stay home alone, you have more freedom.
lines.style: Observant, warm. She's noticing a real shift in Mei's life. Not congratulatory—just acknowledging the practical ease that comes with this stage. Small, knowing smile underneath.
